title: From product goal to ML task
summary: Turn "more engagement" into a prediction with a well-defined label.

choices.text: Predict whether the user clicks the article, and rank by click probability alone.
Predict the probability of a click and the expected read time after a click, and rank by a weighted combination, with the weights tuned in A/B tests.
Predict the number of articles the user will read this week, and show the same list to everyone.
Cluster articles by topic and show the largest cluster first.
